item.g:title: Avnideep Pain Relief Oil 60ml – Nirgundi, Gandhapura & Kapoor for Knee, Back & Joint Pain
item.g:description: Avnideep Ayurvedic Pain Relief Oil, 60ml. A warming massage oil made with Nirgundi, Gandhapura and Kapoor that is traditionally used for knee, back, shoulder and joint discomfort. Non-greasy, quick absorbing and easy to massage into the skin; for external use only. Regular massage helps loosen stiff muscles after a long day, travel or physical work. Made in an AYUSH-certified and GMP-certified facility with batch-wise lab testing for purity. How to use: apply a small quantity on the affected area and massage gently for 5-10 minutes, two to three times a day. Do not apply on broken skin or near the eyes; keep away from children. Free delivery across India, cash on delivery available. This is an Ayurvedic proprietary product, not a medicine: consult a qualified healthcare professional for persistent or severe pain.

item.g:title: Avnideep Herbal Hair Oil 100ml – Bhringraj, Amla, Brahmi & Neem for Strong, Shiny Hair
item.g:description: Avnideep Ayurvedic Herbal Hair Oil, 100ml. A light, non-sticky hair oil made with Bhringraj, Amla, Brahmi and Neem that is traditionally used to support a healthy scalp, reduce dryness and keep hair looking naturally lustrous. Suitable for all hair types, for women and men. How to use: massage a small quantity into the scalp and hair, leave for at least an hour or overnight, then wash with a mild shampoo; use two to three times a week for best results. Made in an AYUSH-certified and GMP-certified facility with batch-wise lab testing. For external use only; do a patch test first and stop if irritation occurs. Free delivery across India, cash on delivery available. Cosmetic preparation: this product does not treat hair loss or any medical condition.
